title_zh: 正则化分数中心化 (Regularized Score Centering)
summary_en: The paper introduces Regularized Score Centering (RSC) to stabilize asynchronous reinforcement learning, which suffers from stale policies and numerical mismatch. RSC adds a reverse KL penalty to score centering (SC) to keep the learner's next-token distribution close to the behavior policy, and works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS). Theoretical analysis shows KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. Evaluated on dense and mixture-of-experts models across six agentic tasks, RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency, achieving top performance with 14.3% improvement on AppWorld and 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.
summary_zh: 本文提出了正则化分数中心化（RSC）以稳定异步强化学习，该方法解决了陈旧策略和训练-推理数值不匹配的问题。RSC在分数中心化（SC）的基础上加入反向KL惩罚，使学习器的下一词元分布靠近行为策略的分布，并且可与截断重要性采样（TIS）结合使用。理论分析表明KL正则化能改善收敛保证。在六个智能体任务上对稠密和混合专家模型进行评估，RSC结合TIS显著提升了样本效率，在AppWorld上提升14.3%，在BabyAI上达到最强基线得分的9.9倍。
content_en: Asynchronous reinforcement learning increases training throughput, but data from stale policies and numerical mismatch between training and inference can destabilize learning. To stabilize off-policy learning, score centering (SC) removes the effect of reward baselines on the expected update. Our gradient diagnostics show less extreme gradients with SC than with importance sampling (IS), but SC can still fail when the learner moves far from the behavior policy that generated the data. To limit this policy mismatch, we introduce Regularized Score Centering (RSC), which adds a reverse Kullback-Leibler (KL) penalty to encourage the learner's next-token distribution to stay close to the behavior policy's next-token distribution. RSC works with or without truncated importance sampling (TIS), which caps token importance weights. Our theoretical analysis supports this approach, showing that KL regularization improves convergence guarantees. We evaluate dense and mixture-of-experts models on mathematical reasoning and agentic tasks, including online shopping, tool use, games, and fully asynchronous software engineering. RSC with TIS substantially improves sample efficiency across all agentic benchmarks, attaining higher training rewards with the same number of sampled responses. In final evaluations, it achieves top performance across all six agentic tasks, improving by 14.3% on AppWorld and reaching 9.9 times the strongest baseline's score on BabyAI.
content_zh: 异步强化学习提高了训练吞吐量，但来自陈旧策略的数据以及训练与推理之间的数值不匹配可能使学习不稳定。为稳定离策略学习，分数中心化（SC）消除了奖励基线对期望更新的影响。我们的梯度诊断显示，与重要性采样（IS）相比，SC 的梯度更不极端，但当学习器远离生成数据的行為策略时，SC 仍可能失败。为限制这种策略不匹配，我们引入了正则化分数中心化（RSC），它添加了一个反向 Kullback-Leibler（KL）惩罚，以鼓励学习器的下一 token 分布保持接近行为策略的下一 token 分布。RSC 在有或没有截断重要性采样（TIS）的情况下均可工作，TIS 会限制 token 重要性权重。我们的理论分析支持这一方法，表明 KL 正则化改善了收敛保证。我们在数学推理和智能体任务上评估了稠密模型和混合专家模型，包括在线购物、工具使用、游戏和完全异步软件工程。RSC 结合 TIS 在所有智能体基准上显著提高了样本效率，在相同采样响应数量下获得了更高的训练奖励。在最终评估中，它在所有六个智能体任务上均取得了最佳性能，在 AppWorld 上提升了 14.3%，在 BabyAI 上达到了最强基线得分的 9.9 倍。
